Artist bio:
[████]
LARS is project leader for building The Synthetic Party at the tech company MindFuture, and has previously been mentioned in the magazine Antipyrine, in an exhibition at the Institute for Emancipatory Science at Spanien19c, as well as on various blogs and social media. A longer version is under construction here: [████]
Contact: [████]
Description:
These six works are based on different plays over the artist subject MARCEL PROUST. The works are embedded in one hypersystem, and there is no recommended route. The images were made with artificial intelligence (VQGAN+CLIP), and the text documents are constructed from generative principles which one can investigate by following the attached links in the titles.
